mapper.select: SELECT model.model_version FROM device JOIN thing_model model ON model.id = device.thing_model_id AND model.model_version = device.model_version WHERE device.id = #{deviceId} AND device.status = 'ACTIVE' AND model.status = 'PUBLISHED'

SELECT parameter.code, parameter.data_type FROM device JOIN thing_model model ON model.id = device.thing_model_id AND model.model_version = device.model_version JOIN thing_model_parameter binding ON binding.thing_model_id = model.id JOIN parameter_definition parameter ON parameter.id = binding.parameter_id WHERE device.id = #{deviceId} AND device.status = 'ACTIVE' AND model.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND parameter.status = 'ACTIVE' AND binding.access_mode IN ('WRITE_ONLY', 'READ_WRITE') ORDER BY binding.sort_order
